libraries.name: @material/web

patterns.formAssociation: Best-in-class mixin architecture. Uses composable mixins: mixinElementInternals -> mixinFormAssociated -> mixinConstraintValidation -> mixinOnReportValidity. Each mixin handles one responsibility. Symbol-based protected API (internals, getFormValue, getFormState, createValidator, getValidityAnchor) prevents naming collisions. Form value synchronization happens in requestUpdate() for synchronous form API compat. Separate Validator class per component with caching.
patterns.theming: SCSS-based with design token CSS custom properties compiled at build time. Uses Sass modules for per-variant style sheets (filled-styles.scss, outlined-styles.scss). Tokens resolve through md-sys-color-* system. No runtime token layer -- all compiled. Each variant is a separate element (md-filled-button, md-outlined-button).
patterns.accessibility: mixinDelegatesAria shifts aria-* attributes from host to data-* attributes to prevent duplicate announcements in Shadow DOM. delegatesFocus: true on all interactive elements. Soft-disabled pattern (focusable but non-interactive) follows ARIA APG guidance. ARIAMixinStrict type for type-safe ARIA property access in templates.
patterns.events: Minimal custom events -- prefers native events (change, input). Uses redispatchEvent() utility to bubble events from internal elements. Custom events only for component-specific actions (opening, opened, closing, closed). No event prefix.
patterns.ssr: First-class SSR support. isServer checks throughout to guard DOM APIs. SSR-specific attributes (display-text, has-leading-icon) for initial render without JS. Declarative shadow DOM support. Value initialization handles streaming DOM case.
patterns.bundling: Per-component entry points. Each variant is a standalone file. Abstract base classes shared via internal imports. Tree-shakeable by design -- import only md-filled-button if you only need that.
patterns.testing: Jasmine + @web/test-runner-playwright. Tests colocated with source (button_test.ts alongside button.ts). Browser-based testing with Playwright.
patterns.cem: Generated CEM. Uses @lit-labs/analyzer. JSDoc-based API documentation. @fires tags for events, @nocollapse for Closure Compiler compat.

strengthsToAdopt: Composable form-association mixins with symbol-based protected API -- eliminates code duplication across all form elements
Synchronous form value sync in requestUpdate() -- critical for form API compatibility that many libraries get wrong
ARIA delegation mixin that shifts aria-* to data-* to prevent duplicate announcements in Shadow DOM
Soft-disabled pattern (focusable but non-interactive) for accessible disabled states per ARIA APG
Constraint validation mixin with Validator class pattern -- type-safe, cacheable, per-component validators
isServer guards for SSR compatibility baked into base classes
Separate abstract base + concrete variants pattern for clean extension
weaknessesHelixAvoids: SCSS build dependency adds complexity -- HELiX correctly uses Lit CSS tagged templates
Separate elements per variant (md-filled-button, md-outlined-button) increases API surface -- HELiX correctly uses a single element with variant property
Closure Compiler constraints pollute the codebase with workarounds
No Storybook stories -- docs are separate catalog app

libraries.name: @shoelace-style/shoelace

patterns.formAssociation: FormControlController (reactive controller pattern) handles form registration, validation, submission. WeakMap-based form tracking. Monitors user interaction via configurable event names (assumeInteractionOn). Manual form submission/reset via controller.submit()/reset(). Does NOT use ElementInternals -- uses hidden input workaround for broader browser compat.
patterns.theming: CSS custom properties via theme stylesheets (light.css, dark.css). Component styles use --sl-* tokens. Base component.styles.ts sets box-sizing inheritance. Separate form-control.styles.ts for shared form layout. Theme loaded as external stylesheet in document.
patterns.accessibility: Comprehensive ARIA attributes in templates. aria-describedby for help text. LocalizeController for i18n of ARIA labels (clearEntry, hidePassword, showPassword). HasSlotController detects slot presence for conditional ARIA. Keyboard handling explicitly coded per component.
patterns.events: Typed emit() method on base class (ShoelaceElement). Events registered on GlobalEventHandlersEventMap for type safety. Conditional detail requirement enforced at type level. sl-* prefixed events. @watch decorator for property change side effects.
patterns.ssr: Limited SSR support. No explicit isServer guards. Components assume DOM availability.
patterns.bundling: Per-component entry points. Static dependencies declaration for auto-registration of child components (sl-icon, sl-spinner). Tree-shakeable imports.
patterns.testing: @web/test-runner with Playwright. Chromium + WebKit browsers. Per-component test groups via globbySync. esbuild plugin for TypeScript. 3-second timeout with 1 retry.
patterns.cem: Rich CEM config with custom plugins: infer tag names from file paths, custom JSDoc tags (@animation, @dependency, @since, @status), React event name generation, VS Code/JetBrains/Vue integration plugins. Module path translation for dist output.

strengthsToAdopt: Typed emit() method on base class with GlobalEventHandlersEventMap registration -- compile-time event type safety
@watch decorator for clean property change side effects without overriding updated()
@defaultValue decorator for form reset behavior -- tracks initial attribute value separately
HasSlotController for conditional rendering based on slot presence -- avoids empty wrapper elements
Static dependencies map for auto-registration of child components
CEM plugins for VS Code, JetBrains, and Vue type generation -- IDE integration
FormControlController as reactive controller pattern -- composable and testable
Per-component test groups for targeted test runs
weaknessesHelixAvoids: No ElementInternals -- uses hidden input workaround for form association, which is fragile
Limited SSR support -- no isServer guards
WebKit browser testing disabled in config (Firefox 'started failing randomly') -- HELiX should maintain stable cross-browser testing

libraries.name: @lion/root

patterns.formAssociation: Deep form system: FormControlMixin, FormatMixin, InteractionStateMixin, NativeTextFieldMixin. Validation architecture with typed validators (Required, StringValidators, NumberValidators, DateValidators), ResultValidator for cross-field validation. Async validation queue. Unparseable type for handling invalid parse states while still validating. FocusMixin for consistent focus management.
patterns.theming: Intentionally unstyled -- provides only behavior and accessibility. Consumers provide all styling. This is the 'headless UI' approach.
patterns.accessibility: FocusMixin handles focus delegation. Validation feedback via LionValidationFeedback component. SyncUpdatableMixin ensures synchronous property updates for ARIA state consistency. Localize integration for error messages.
patterns.events: Standard CustomEvent dispatch. No typed event system. Relies on Lit property change callbacks.
patterns.bundling: Monorepo with per-package entry points (e.g., @lion/ui/input-date). ScopedElementsMixin for scoped custom element registration -- allows multiple versions on same page.
patterns.testing: @lit-labs/testing, Mocha, Chai. Puppeteer for browser automation. Integration tests with real form submission.

strengthsToAdopt: Validation architecture with typed validator classes, async validation queue, and ResultValidator for cross-field validation
Unparseable type for handling invalid input states while still running validators -- critical for healthcare forms
ScopedElementsMixin for version-safe custom element registration -- enterprise requirement for gradual upgrades
FormatMixin separating parse/format/serialize concerns -- clean data pipeline for form values
InteractionStateMixin tracking dirty/touched/prefilled states -- standard form UX patterns
weaknessesHelixAvoids: Intentionally unstyled means consumers must build entire design system on top -- HELiX correctly provides opinionated design
Heavy mixin chain (5+ deep) creates complex class hierarchies -- HELiX should prefer composition
Plain JavaScript (not TypeScript) source -- HELiX correctly mandates TypeScript strict

libraries.name: @vaadin/web-components

patterns.formAssociation: Mixin-based: ActiveMixin, FocusMixin, TabindexMixin compose into ButtonMixin. Vaadin uses Polymer-era static properties pattern with camelToDash conversion. FieldBase provides common field structure.
patterns.theming: Lumo and Material theme variants via injector pattern. Themes as separate packages. CSS custom properties (--vaadin-* and --lumo-*). Theme overlay architecture for component-specific overrides.
patterns.accessibility: Dedicated @vaadin/a11y-base package with ActiveMixin, FocusMixin, TabindexMixin, DisabledMixin. Role-based components (role='button' set in ready()). _activeKeys pattern for keyboard activation.
patterns.events: Standard DOM events. Vaadin-specific events for complex components (grid, combo-box). Event suppression on disabled elements via stopImmediatePropagation.
patterns.ssr: Server-side rendering via Java backend (Vaadin Flow). Web components serve as thin frontend layer. Not relevant to HELiX architecture.
patterns.bundling: Per-package entry points. Lerna monorepo. Each component is separate npm package.
patterns.testing: @web/test-runner with Playwright. Visual regression testing via @web/test-runner-visual-regression. Testing helpers package.
patterns.cem: Sophisticated CEM config with custom plugins: mixesPlugin for JSDoc @mixes tag resolution, readonlyPlugin for readonly property detection, classPrivacyPlugin for @private/@protected filtering. Extensive post-processing to clean up inherited members, private APIs, and attribute naming.

strengthsToAdopt: Dedicated a11y-base package with composable accessibility mixins (ActiveMixin, FocusMixin, TabindexMixin, DisabledMixin)
Event suppression pattern on disabled elements using stopImmediatePropagation in capture phase
Visual regression testing integrated into test runner
CEM plugin for resolving @mixes JSDoc tags to cross-package mixin references
CEM post-processing to filter private/protected members and normalize attribute naming
weaknessesHelixAvoids: Polymer-era patterns (static get properties, ready() lifecycle) -- HELiX correctly uses modern Lit decorators
Java server dependency for full functionality -- HELiX correctly targets static/CDN deployment
Plain JavaScript source (not TypeScript) -- HELiX mandates strict TypeScript

patterns.theming: Adobe Spectrum design tokens. CSS files compiled from Spectrum CSS source. Per-component CSS overrides (button-overrides.css). SizedMixin for standardized size variants. Theme provider component.

patterns.ssr: 2nd-gen rewrite in progress. Limited SSR focus in 1st-gen.
patterns.bundling: Per-package monorepo (68 packages). Each component is standalone npm package. Heavy -- many small packages.
patterns.testing: @open-wc/testing + @web/test-runner-commands. a11ySnapshot for accessibility tree verification. sinon for mocks/stubs.

recommendations.title: Adopt Material Web's form association mixin architecture
recommendations.description: Extract HELiX's inline ElementInternals code into composable mixins: mixinElementInternals, mixinFormAssociated, mixinConstraintValidation. Use Symbol-based protected API to prevent naming collisions. Material Web's pattern of syncing form values in requestUpdate() (not updated()) ensures synchronous form API compatibility. With 78 components and many form elements, this eliminates massive code duplication and ensures consistent form behavior.
recommendations.helixImpact: Create packages/hx-library/src/mixins/ directory with FormAssociatedMixin, ConstraintValidationMixin, ElementInternalsMixin. Refactor hx-button, hx-text-input, hx-select, hx-checkbox, and all form elements to use these mixins instead of inline attachInternals() + manual setFormValue() calls. Reduces per-component form boilerplate from ~20 lines to ~5 lines.

recommendations.title: Adopt Shoelace's typed emit() method on base element
recommendations.description: Create a HelixElement base class (extending LitElement) with a typed emit() method that registers events on GlobalEventHandlersEventMap. This provides compile-time type safety for event detail payloads, enforces consistent event options (bubbles: true, composed: true), and eliminates the manual new CustomEvent() boilerplate scattered across all 78 components. Shoelace's type-level enforcement of required detail properties is particularly valuable.
recommendations.helixImpact: Create HelixElement base class in packages/hx-library/src/internal/helix-element.ts. All components extend HelixElement instead of LitElement directly. Add GlobalEventHandlersEventMap declarations for all hx-* events. Replace all manual dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent(...)) with this.emit('hx-click', { detail: ... }).

recommendations.title: Adopt Material Web's ARIA delegation mixin
recommendations.description: Shadow DOM causes duplicate ARIA announcements when aria-* attributes exist on both host and internal elements. Material Web's mixinDelegatesAria shifts aria-* attributes to data-* attributes on the host, preventing double-announcement while preserving the property values for template binding. This is a critical accessibility fix for healthcare -- screenreader users hearing every label twice is a WCAG failure in practice.
recommendations.helixImpact: Add mixinDelegatesAria to HelixElement base class. Remove manual aria-label property forwarding from hx-button, hx-text-input, and all interactive elements. The mixin handles this automatically. Requires delegatesFocus: true on all interactive element shadow roots.

recommendations.title: Adopt Shoelace's @watch decorator pattern
recommendations.description: The @watch decorator provides clean property change side effects without overriding updated() or willUpdate(). It fires before the component updates, supports waitUntilFirstUpdate option, and receives both old and new values. Multiple @watch decorators can be used on different properties without conflict. This is cleaner than the switch/if chains in updated() that HELiX currently uses.
recommendations.helixImpact: Add @watch decorator to packages/hx-library/src/internal/watch.ts. Refactor components that have complex updated() methods to use @watch for individual property reactions. Particularly valuable for form validation triggers, ARIA state updates, and conditional rendering.

recommendations.title: Adopt Lion's validation architecture for healthcare forms
recommendations.description: Lion's validation system provides: typed Validator classes (Required, StringValidators, NumberValidators, DateValidators), ResultValidator for cross-field validation, async validation queue, and the Unparseable type for handling invalid input states while still running validators. For healthcare forms where validation accuracy is critical (medication dosages, patient IDs, date ranges), this architecture prevents entire categories of validation bugs.
recommendations.helixImpact: Create packages/hx-library/src/validation/ with Validator base class, built-in validators (Required, MinLength, MaxLength, Pattern, Min, Max, DateRange), and ValidationController. Integrate with form association mixins. Components like hx-text-input, hx-number-input, hx-date-picker gain declarative validation: <hx-text-input .validators=${[new Required(), new MinLength(3)]}>

recommendations.title: Adopt Shoelace's HasSlotController for conditional rendering
recommendations.description: HasSlotController monitors slot presence via slotchange events and mutation observers. Components can conditionally render wrapper elements only when slots are populated, reducing DOM weight and preventing empty slot containers from affecting layout. Particularly valuable for HELiX's prefix/suffix/help-text patterns where empty wrappers can create unwanted spacing.
recommendations.helixImpact: Add HasSlotController to packages/hx-library/src/internal/slot.ts. Apply to all components with named slots (hx-button prefix/suffix, hx-text-input prefix/suffix/help-text/error, hx-card header/footer). Reduces DOM weight and fixes layout issues with empty slots.

recommendations.title: Adopt Shoelace's @defaultValue decorator for form reset
recommendations.description: The @defaultValue decorator tracks the initial attribute value separately from the current value, enabling proper form reset behavior. Without this, components either fail to reset to their initial value or must manually track defaults. Shoelace's implementation hooks into attributeChangedCallback to capture the initial attribute value before any property changes.
recommendations.helixImpact: Add @defaultValue decorator to packages/hx-library/src/internal/default-value.ts. Apply to all form elements (hx-text-input, hx-textarea, hx-select, hx-checkbox, etc.) so formResetCallback() can restore the original attribute value.

recommendations.title: Add isServer guards for Lit SSR compatibility
recommendations.description: Material Web and FAST both demonstrate isServer guard patterns for SSR-safe components. While HELiX's primary consumer is Drupal (which server-renders Twig templates and hydrates client-side), SSR compatibility ensures components work in Next.js, Astro, and other SSR frameworks. The cost is minimal -- add isServer checks before addEventListener, DOM queries, and window/document access.
recommendations.helixImpact: Audit all components for DOM API usage in constructors, connectedCallback, and property setters. Add isServer guards from 'lit'. Primary areas: constructor event listeners (hx-button click handler), querySelector calls, window/document access. Low effort, high compatibility payoff.

recommendations.title: Adopt Material Web's soft-disabled pattern
recommendations.description: Standard disabled removes elements from tab order, making them invisible to keyboard users. Material Web's soft-disabled pattern keeps elements focusable but non-interactive, with aria-disabled='true' instead of the disabled attribute. This follows ARIA APG guidance for when disabled controls need increased visibility. Critical for healthcare where a disabled 'Submit Prescription' button must still be discoverable.
recommendations.helixImpact: Add soft-disabled property to all interactive HELiX components. When soft-disabled: element remains in tab order, aria-disabled='true' is set, click/interaction is suppressed via stopImmediatePropagation, visual styling indicates non-interactive state. Approximately 2-3 hours per component to implement.

recommendations.title: Adopt Spectrum's a11ySnapshot testing pattern
recommendations.description: Testing ARIA attributes in the DOM does not guarantee correct screenreader behavior. Spectrum and other libraries use a11ySnapshot from @web/test-runner-commands to capture the actual accessibility tree and verify node roles, names, and states. This catches bugs that attribute-level testing misses, like aria-label being ignored due to role conflicts.
recommendations.helixImpact: Add @web/test-runner-commands to test dependencies (or equivalent for Vitest browser mode). Add accessibility tree verification tests alongside existing ARIA attribute tests. Priority: form elements (hx-text-input, hx-select, hx-checkbox) and interactive elements (hx-button, hx-dialog, hx-tabs).

recommendations.title: Enhance CEM config with Shoelace and Vaadin patterns
recommendations.description: Shoelace generates VS Code, JetBrains, and Vue type definitions from CEM. Vaadin has sophisticated post-processing plugins for filtering private members, resolving mixin references, normalizing attribute names, and marking readonly properties. Combined, these patterns would give HELiX CEM output that powers IDE autocomplete across all major editors and frameworks.
recommendations.helixImpact: Add CEM plugins: custom-element-vs-code-integration, custom-element-jet-brains-integration, custom-element-vuejs-integration. Add post-processing to filter private/protected members, normalize hx-* attribute names, and resolve mixin inheritance chains. Improves DX for all consumers.

recommendations.title: Adopt Vaadin's visual regression testing
recommendations.description: Vaadin integrates @web/test-runner-visual-regression for screenshot-based testing. For a healthcare design system where visual consistency is critical (e.g., error states must always be red, disabled states must always be muted), visual regression catches CSS changes that functional tests miss.
recommendations.helixImpact: Add visual regression testing to HELiX's Vitest/Playwright setup. Capture baseline screenshots for all component variants and states. Run on every PR to catch unintended visual changes. Integrate with existing __screenshots__ directories already present in component folders.

recommendations.title: Adopt Shoelace's static dependencies pattern
recommendations.description: Shoelace components declare their child component dependencies as a static map: static dependencies = { 'sl-icon': SlIcon, 'sl-spinner': SlSpinner }. This enables lazy/scoped registration without global side effects and makes dependency graphs explicit and analyzable.
recommendations.helixImpact: Add static dependencies to components that compose other HELiX components (hx-select using hx-popover, hx-date-picker using hx-popover + hx-text-input, etc.). Enables future scoped registration and makes the component dependency graph explicit in code.

recommendations.title: Adopt Spectrum's PendingStateController for async operations
recommendations.description: Spectrum's PendingStateController standardizes loading/pending state management. Components that trigger async operations (form submission, data fetching, file upload) get consistent loading UI, aria-busy management, and interaction prevention. This is a reactive controller that composes cleanly with other controllers.
recommendations.helixImpact: Create PendingStateController in packages/hx-library/src/controllers/. Apply to hx-button (already has loading state), hx-file-upload, hx-data-table (loading rows), hx-select (async options). Standardizes the loading pattern currently implemented ad-hoc per component.

recommendations.title: Evaluate Biome as ESLint replacement for performance
recommendations.description: Porsche Design System uses Biome (Rust-based linter/formatter) which is significantly faster than ESLint+Prettier. With 78 components and growing, lint/format time in CI becomes meaningful. Biome combines linting and formatting in a single pass.
recommendations.helixImpact: Benchmark Biome vs current ESLint+Prettier on HELiX codebase. If CI lint time exceeds 30 seconds, consider migration. Risk: Biome has fewer rules than ESLint ecosystem. Evaluate after v1.0 when stability is more critical than build speed.

formAssociationApproaches.helixCurrent: Inline attachInternals() per component (ADEQUATE but duplicative)
